blocks.text: 1. EfficientNet

blocks.alt: A baseline network goes through compound scaling to become the EfficientNet family

blocks.text: MobileNet, the previous topic, offered separate width and resolution multipliers to tune. EfficientNet systematically studies how to scale networks optimally, explored throughout this topic.
Rather than tuning depth, width, and resolution separately, it scales all three together, a genuinely systematic approach covered in complete depth throughout the rest of this topic.
2. The Scaling Question

This connects back to VGG's depth variants, already covered, and MobileNet's width and resolution multipliers, already covered. Every earlier architecture in this module scaled just one or two dimensions at a time.
EfficientNet genuinely asked whether scaling all three dimensions together might work better, a genuinely natural question given the separate scaling knobs already covered throughout this module.
3. The Three Scaling Dimensions

blocks.alt: Depth, width, and resolution are scaled together

blocks.text: The genuinely three dimensions EfficientNet studies together connect back to Network Architecture, already covered. Depth means how many layers; width means how many channels; resolution means how large the input image is.

These three dimensions, individually already covered in earlier topics throughout this course, together form the genuinely complete design space that EfficientNet explores in a coordinated, systematic way.

blocks.text: 4. Compound Scaling

blocks.alt: Scaling one dimension alone is compared against scaling all dimensions together

blocks.text: This connects back to the three scaling dimensions, already covered in this topic. EfficientNet's genuinely core idea, called compound scaling, increases depth, width, and resolution together, by a fixed, coordinated ratio.
This holds rather than growing just one dimension while leaving the others genuinely fixed, the exact limitation already covered as the scaling question motivating this entire topic.
5. Why Coordinated Scaling Genuinely Helps

A genuinely important intuitive justification connects back to Receptive Field, already covered in its own topic. A genuinely larger input image needs genuinely more layers and channels to process it well.

If only resolution grew while depth and width stayed genuinely fixed, already covered as the limitation this topic addresses, the network's own receptive field, already covered, might not grow proportionally to actually cover the larger image well.

blocks.content: This intuition, already covered in this topic, is genuinely why compound scaling often outperforms scaling just one dimension alone: the three dimensions genuinely interact, so coordinating them together makes genuine architectural sense.

blocks.text: 6. Neural Architecture Search

blocks.alt: A search space feeds neural architecture search to produce an optimized baseline

blocks.text: This connects back to Hyperparameter Tuning, already covered in its own module. EfficientNet's own base architecture came from a genuinely systematic search process, not manual design alone.
This is similar in spirit to the search strategies already covered throughout that earlier module, applied here to searching over architectural choices rather than just training hyperparameters.
7. A Family Of Efficiently Scaled Models

blocks.alt: EfficientNet ranges from B0 to B4 to B7

blocks.text: A genuinely practical result connects back to a family of variants, already covered in MobileNet. EfficientNet genuinely produces a whole family of models, each scaled by the same coordinated compound scaling rule already covered in this topic.
This gives practitioners a genuinely principled range of choices, from smaller, faster variants to larger, more accurate ones, all derived consistently from the same underlying scaling formula.
8. Strong Accuracy-Efficiency Results

blocks.alt: EfficientNet is compared against prior hand-tuned CNNs

blocks.text: This connects back to the accuracy-efficiency tradeoff, already covered in MobileNet. EfficientNet genuinely achieved strong accuracy with genuinely far fewer parameters than earlier architectures at comparable accuracy.

This is a genuinely direct validation of the compound scaling idea already covered in this topic, demonstrating that a genuinely principled scaling approach can outperform less coordinated scaling strategies.

blocks.text: 9. Recognizing When EfficientNet's Approach Is Genuinely Valuable

blocks.alt: Needing the best accuracy per FLOP points toward using EfficientNet

blocks.text: Needing to genuinely scale a network up or down systematically for different resource budgets is a direct case where compound scaling, already covered in this topic, directly provides a principled way to do this.

Wanting genuinely strong accuracy per parameter, more so than raw parameter minimization alone, is another genuine case where EfficientNet, already covered, genuinely optimizes precisely for that balance.
10. Worked Example

The example below directly demonstrates compound scaling's own coordinated approach, computing depth, width, and resolution multipliers together from a single scaling factor, illustrating the concepts already covered throughout this topic.

code.content:
def compound_scale(base_depth, base_width, base_resolution, phi, alpha=1.2, beta=1.1, gamma=1.15):
    # already covered as compound scaling in this topic: a single coefficient phi scales all three dimensions together
    depth = base_depth * (alpha ** phi)
    width = base_width * (beta ** phi)
    resolution = base_resolution * (gamma ** phi)
    return depth, width, resolution

base_depth, base_width, base_resolution = 10, 32, 224  # a genuinely simplified baseline network

for phi in [0, 1, 2, 3]:  # already covered as the family of efficiently scaled models in this topic
    depth, width, resolution = compound_scale(base_depth, base_width, base_resolution, phi)
    print(f"phi={phi}: depth={depth:.1f}, width={width:.1f}, resolution={resolution:.1f}")

print("\nNotice all three dimensions genuinely grow together as phi increases, already covered as coordinated scaling in this topic")

blocks.text: 11. Convolutional Neural Networks: Architecture Progress Recap

items: EfficientNet systematically scales depth, width, and resolution together, rather than one at a time.
Depth means layer count, width means channel count, resolution means input image size.
Compound scaling increases all three dimensions together, by a fixed, coordinated ratio.
A larger input image needs proportionally more layers and channels to process it well.
Its base architecture came from a systematic Neural Architecture Search process.
It produces a family of models, all derived from the same coordinated scaling formula.
It achieved strong accuracy with far fewer parameters than earlier architectures at comparable accuracy.
